scope: all open issues in BlueFissionTech/opus at capture time; not all issues in sibling repositories

inventory.exhaustiveness_basis: Direct canonical repository issues API returned the same 56 non-PR issues; one page below 100 items.

planning_semantics: Each row stages one bounded next deliverable. Planned or dependency-gated does not mean implemented, released or deployed. Issue closure requires full parent acceptance. No new priority label or date commitment is implied.
operator_sequence: one Arkheion add-on MVP at a time
paid multi-tenant services and microservices after proof
